findings.title: Truc Co specials cast FREE - resourceCostPercentOfMax never stamped (30% MaxLL live cost dead)
findings.discoveredBy: cleanA COR + cleanA AUT + cleanA INT (convergent)
findings.counterexample: requiredResourceFor reads absent field -> 0 -> hasResourceFor passes; commit skips consume. All 5 specials permanently free.
findings.expected: spec D8/F10: 30% maxMp live at cast, legality-rejected, charged at commit.
findings.fix: resolveSpecialUltimate stamps resourceCostPercentOfMax: PHAP_TU_TRANG_COST_PERCENT_OF_MAX on the converted def.

findings.title: PHAP_TU_WINDOW_LANDED_CONSEQUENCES never attached - van_moc/kim_y/trong_nhac windows inert
findings.discoveredBy: cleanA COR + cleanA AUT + cleanA INT (convergent)
findings.counterexample: Zero production consumers of the table; sinh_co/kim_liet/trong_the markers never plant; 3 of 5 specials are inert self-buffs.
findings.expected: spec D10/D11: landed basic during window runs the authored marker lane.
findings.fix: resolveBasic stamps landedConsequences from PHAP_TU_WINDOW_LANDED_CONSEQUENCES[element]; empowered inherits via {...stamped}.

findings.title: penetrationFromStacks never stamped on metal basic - Kim Liet pierce scaling dead
findings.counterexample: No producer of penetrationFromStacks; even with windows attached, kim_liet stacks accumulated with zero pierce effect.
findings.expected: spec D11 / INV-10: metal basic carries penetrationFromStacks bound to kim_liet on normal + empowered.
findings.fix: resolveBasic stamps penetrationFromStacks{ailmentId:'kim_liet',perStack} on the metal basic; empowered inherits.

findings.title: Empowered (Phap The) variant dropped theGainOnLandedCast - empowered casts granted 0 The
findings.counterexample: buildPhapTheVariant ran on pre-stamp resolved; outer spread applied theGainOnLandedCast only to the basic.
findings.expected: spec D2 / INV-1: empowered cast still mints +1 The.
findings.fix: Stamp moved BEFORE buildPhapTheVariant(element, stamped) so {...base} inherits it.

findings.title: boundToSourceBuffId markers outlive window by one runPhaseB boundary
findings.counterexample: Bound sweep precedes decrement/expiry; a window expiring in the same pass leaves markers alive one boundary - stale sinh_co could feed applyPeriodicGrowth.
findings.expected: spec D10: marker dies the moment source no longer holds the window.
findings.fix: runPhaseB (5b): bound re-sweep after expiry step retires orphaned markers immediately.

findings.title: TechniqueGateAuthored 'frozen surplus' test expectation wrong for new gate ladder
findings.counterexample: Test expected canUpgradeNode=true at rank 3 under the retired 6@3/9@6 ladder; new MINOR_TIER_GATES {3@2,4@3,5@4} means rank 4 resumes.
findings.expected: owned L4 resumes upgrading at rank 4 under the new ladder.
findings.fix: Test pins rank3->false, rank4->true with the atLevel:5 gate comment.

findings.title: THE_BAR_MAX literal 5 duplicated canonical SPELL_PATH_MAX_THE
findings.counterexample: Second hard-coded 5 on the presentation side; two edit points for one rule.
findings.fix: THE_BAR_MAX = SPELL_PATH_MAX_THE import.

findings.title: AoE secondary onLanded effects fired per-target instead of once-per-cast
findings.counterexample: secondary deal_damage/buff lanes authored oncePerCast fired on every hit target; AoE multi-hit stacked consequences.
findings.expected: flagged secondary fires at most once per cast regardless of hit count.
findings.fix: priorLandedHitOpIds accumulator -> ops_landed_any read on this lane's priors -> flagged secondary wrapped in branch{var lt 1}; + SNAPSHOT BUG found by pin test: reference capture let later lanes poison the read - fixed via operationIds:[...priors]; pin test asserts exact other-lane id coverage.

findings.title: Ho The DR unclamped - could exceed cap when mp pool anomalies
findings.counterexample: linhLucHoTheCap * (currentMp/maxMp) unclamped if currentMp > maxMp.
findings.fix: Math.min(1, ratio) clamp.

findings.title: selectSpellPathElement had no mid-battle guard - element switchable during combat
findings.counterexample: Element commit callable while a turn battle was live - swaps the resolved basic mid-fight.
findings.expected: commit blocked while battle in progress (matches other path ops).
findings.fix: isTurnBattleInProgress() early-return guard.

findings.title: theGainOnLandedCast grant emitted per execution (follow-up repeats/multicast) not per cast
findings.counterexample: emitGrants fired on every spawned follow-up execution, so multicast/repeat plans minted extra The.
findings.expected: grant per cast ACTION (root plan only).
findings.fix: emitGrants early-returns when plan.subcastIndex > 0 (composite extras already suppressed via flag).

findings.title: Coordinator-found: ops_landed_any read captured priorLandedHitOpIds BY REFERENCE - later lanes poisoned the dedup var
findings.discoveredBy: coordinator pin test (SkillResolver.test.ts oncePerCast lane coverage)
findings.counterexample: The accumulating array was referenced, not copied: lane B's own pushed hit id entered the read -> secondary suppressed even when lane A missed.
findings.expected: read must pin THIS lane's priors only.
findings.fix: operationIds: [...priorLandedHitOpIds] snapshot + comment; pin test asserts reads.get(opcastVar) equals OTHER lane's hit ids exactly.

findings.title: Comment mojibake + splice damage during ascii-ratchet transliteration sweep
findings.counterexample: First transliteration pass over-stripped (raw-text baseline keys); restore pass paired ranges by index and spliced comment text into code lines in CombatScene.ts.
findings.expected: only unrecorded non-ASCII tokens stripped; baseline-recorded tokens untouched.
findings.fix: CombatScene.ts restored to HEAD (damage-only diff); rebuild pass reconstructed files as HEAD + non-comment changes; fix2 pass with exact helper semantics stripped only unrecorded tokens; asciiComments green.

findings.title: Moc window lane dead -- non-damaging basic never consumes landedConsequences
findings.counterexample: doc_chuong authors zero damage (PoisonPath sec.1) so it routes to the for_each_target lane; landedConsequences' sole consumer sat inside adaptDamageOp -- the van_moc->sinh_co plant never fired.
findings.expected: spec D11/D15: Sinh Co marker plants on the first own-source landed Moc basic while van_moc is up.
findings.fix: Non-damaging enemy-scope lane appends def.landedConsequences per loop target (landing = application); pin test in LegacySkillAdapter.test.ts.

findings.title: Water empowered rider hardcodes han_tuc chance 0.5 (specialization authors 0.65/0.4)
findings.counterexample: Secondary hit applies han_tuc at fixed 0.5 while the specialization-modified primary applies 0.65 (Ngung Lien) or 0.4 (Dao Lan).
findings.expected: Reviewer expectation: rider mirrors the primary's effective chance.
findings.rejectionReason: Spec D4 pins no chance for the secondary's ailment application -- the rider is a distinct authored op, and its 0.5 equals the BASE authored chance. Specialization parity would require a new resolve-time seam (writing the modified value into a static consequence table). Recorded as design observation; revisit if spec pins the rule.

findings.title: saveVersion.ts header omits the v85 changelog entry
findings.counterexample: CURRENT_SAVE_VERSION = 85 has no changelog line; a retire-heavy pass leaves no trail in the file.
findings.fix: v85 changelog entry added (route slots / kiem_tu queue / the_tu_an ops pane retirements).

findings.title: Bound marker pays one last periodic_growth tick after mid-action window loss
findings.counterexample: runPeriodicPhase ticks BEFORE runPhaseB's bound re-sweep; a marker whose bound window expired mid-action still feeds one periodic_growth grant (and consumes) in the gap.
findings.fix: applyPeriodicGrowth skips a marker whose boundToSourceBuffId source no longer holds the window (same liveness rule as the (5b) re-sweep).

findings.title: Resolved TODO(coordinator) left in the metal window lane comment
findings.fix: TODO replaced with the verified ordering (penetrationFromStacks reads pre-apply stacks).

findings.title: Dead routeProfileProvider stubs left in 2 test fixtures after route retirement
findings.fix: Unused throwing stubs removed from both fixtures.

findings.title: LegacySkillAdapter header still maps theGainOnCrit -> grants.theOnCrit (field retired)
findings.fix: Retired theOnCrit mapping line removed from the header.

findings.title: grantTheFromCast duplicates the TheEconomy.grantThe clamp inline
findings.fix: grantTheFromCast delegates to TheEconomy.grantThe (single cap authority).

findings.title: Stale emitGrants doc comment claims follow-up executions mint The; engine-lane divergence is latent
findings.counterexample: Doc said 'root plans AND follow-up executions' but subcastIndex>0 suppresses them. The engine lane (runtime===undefined) is NOT gated on executionCommitsCast -- latent divergence, reachable only in unit-test harnesses (production always mints a runtime).
findings.fix: Comment corrected to root-plan-only semantics. Engine-lane divergence recorded as latent (no live consumer).

findings.title: hitOpIdsByTarget accumulates secondary-hit ops -- future target_hit_landed gate could open on a secondary's landing
findings.counterexample: Per-target map records every hit op aimed at the target including secondaries minted by other lanes; a lane whose primary whiffed could still see target_hit_landed true if an earlier lane's secondary landed on it.
findings.rejectionReason: Latent today: the only authored consumer (water rider) sits inside the oncePerCast dedup wrapper, so the dedup suppresses it first; adversarial execution tests confirm no live leak. Recorded as a lesson -- if a future lane authors target_hit_landed without the flag, scope the map to lane-primary hits.

findings.title: PHAP_TU_SPECIAL_COOLDOWN_TURNS(5) > PHAP_TRANG_TURNS(3) makes keep/refresh window semantics unreachable at authored numbers
findings.counterexample: Window (3 turns) always expires before the special's cooldown (5 turns) permits recast; keep/refresh branch is dead at current authored numbers.
findings.rejectionReason: Both numbers are spec-authored; the refresh path exists for retuning. No behavioral defect -- design observation only.
